play.definition: An aggressive punt-rush play in which one or more receiving-team players attack the punt protection immediately after the snap with the intent to reach the punter and contact the football during the kicking operation. Rushers may attack an edge, interior gap, overload, stunt, or delayed lane, while other players contain a fake, occupy protectors, maintain a return option, or prepare to recover a blocked or deflected ball.

Action_BlockPunt.label: Block Punt
Action_BlockPunt.definition: A special-teams player's action of penetrating the punt protection and making contact with the football during or immediately after the punter's kicking motion, preventing or significantly altering the punt.

Action_None.label: None
Action_None.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

Action_PuntBall.label: Punt Ball
Action_PuntBall.definition: A punter's action of dropping the football and striking it with the foot to send it downfield on a punt play.

Action_SecureRecovery.label: Secure Recovery
Action_SecureRecovery.definition: A player's successful establishment of clear possession and control of a previously loose or kicked football during a recovery attempt.

Action_SnapReceive.label: Snap Receive
Action_SnapReceive.definition: The action of the quarterback securing the ball from the center’s snap to initiate the play.
